title: Spectral Schur analysis of structured moment matrices for quadratic histopolation
summary: In this paper we study parameter-dependent structured moment matrices with a canonical block form arising from weighted quadratic histopolation on simplicial meshes. For a strictly positive density on a simplex, we construct compatible face densities and an orthogonal decomposition of the quadratic polynomial space into face and interior components, which induces a natural face-interior block structure.
